message: Ready to buy today, no add-ons, pay in full.

Thanks for the offer, and I appreciate that you're ready to buy today and pay in full. $31,000 is quite a bit below what we can do on the T45 Utility, though. It's a 45 hp 4WD machine with a Cat I/II 3-point hitch and 540 PTO, well suited to brush hogging, loader work, and tilling on 10-50 acres. For a same-day, paid-in-full purchase, I can offer it at $40,000.
Heartland posts the T45 at $40,750. I can close right now at $34,000.

I appreciate you sharing that. I can't verify Heartland's pricing, but I want to earn your business today. $34,000 is below what I'm able to do on the T45. I'll come down to $38,500 for a same-day, paid-in-full purchase. That's a solid price on a new 45 hp 4WD utility tractor with a Cat I/II hitch and 540 PTO.
$35,000 is my firm ceiling; I'll pay immediately if you accept.

I understand you're working with a firm number, and I'd like to make this happen today. $35,000 doesn't work for us on the T45 by itself. I can meet you closer, though: $37,000 for the T45 Utility, paid in full today. If budget is the main constraint, another option is $37,500 with delivery and setup included. That gets the tractor to your site, set up, and walked through with you. Either way, it's a strong value on a new 45 hp 4WD utility tractor.
Final offer: $35,500, paid now. Otherwise I have to walk.

I respect that you've been straightforward, and I'd like to close this today. I can't go to $35,500 on the T45, but I'll go to $36,500, paid in full today. That's my best and final number on a new 45 hp 4WD utility tractor with a Cat I/II 3-point hitch and 540 PTO. It's $1,000 from your offer, and I'm ready to finalize the moment you confirm.
$35,600 is absolutely the most I'm authorized to pay. Accept and I pay this minute; otherwise no deal.

I appreciate your persistence and the readiness to pay today. $35,600 is below what I can do on the T45 Utility, so I can't accept it. $36,500 paid in full today is genuinely the lowest price I can offer on this tractor. It's only $900 above your number. If you can get approval for that, I'll finalize it immediately. If the budget can't move, the T25 Compact is a lower-priced option, though it's a smaller 25 hp machine better suited to properties under 10 acres.
